newsitem.title: USA: Woolworth Feb same-store sales off 0.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Woolworth Feb same-store sales off 0.1 pct.

text.p: Woolworth Corp Thursday reported sales for the four-week period ended March 1, 1997, of $528 million, up 0.8 percent from the year ago's $524 million, while same-store sales decreased 0.1 percent.

Excluding the effect of translation rates, particularly as related to our German operations, sales for the four-week period increased 3.6 percent, the company said. Sales of businesses disposed of during 1996 and 1997 have been excluded from all calculations.
